title: OSError: [Errno 8] Exec format error from ros2 run with a Python node in an ament_cmake package: shebangs, install(PROGRAMS), No executable found and ModuleNotFoundError, measured
excerpt: Why a Python node in a C++ (ament_cmake) package fails with Exec format error, No executable found, python3\r or ModuleNotFoundError, what ros2 pkg executables shows, how --symlink-install changes it, and the CMakeLists.txt that worked on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
